description: Human in the loop means a person approves or decides at set points while AI does the rest. Which steps should wait for you, with a real example.
h1: What is human in the loop?
definition: Human in the loop means a person approves, corrects or decides at set points while AI or automation does the rest of the work.
The point is to keep people on the decisions that are costly to get wrong, not on every step.

example.ask: Set up an AI agent that reads new support emails, drafts a reply from what you know about my business, and asks me before sending
example.why: The loop is the reply to your customer. The AI agent reads and drafts on its own; each draft waits in Needs you with Approve and send, Change or Decline, and your changes teach its next drafts.
